instance_url.title: Unleash instance URL
instance_url.description: The instance root, including any base path, without /api (for example https://example.com/unleash).

personal_access_token.title: Unleash personal access token
personal_access_token.description: In Unleash, open your avatar → View profile settings → Personal API tokens → New token. Name it for your AI agent and choose an expiry. It gives the agent your permissions; the app uses a separate SDK token. Copy the full token here (shown once), never into chat. Help: https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#personal-access-tokens
